definitions.ask: Once #322 is releasable, raise a gate whose approval runs the steward's own merge command?
definitions.why: Merge authority is off, so a human must act; the gate hands you that one exact command

choices.label: One gate runs the steward's exact merge argv; a hand merge or enabling steward merges also works
No gate; only poll up to 72h for you or the steward to merge, else the phase ends canceled

definitions.ask: Rehearse release.yml on the refreshed release PR branch before the version is tagged?
definitions.why: The train has never finished a run; its last rehearsal (2026-10-25) was red

choices.label: One rehearse-mode run (about 2h of Actions) proves the train before a break can burn 0.19.0
Go straight to the real release; faster, but a train break at the tag burns 0.19.0
